content: Yesu Akanguisa Yala Uakalepa
Omo Yesu uakovelele mu vuato, uajavukikile musinia, kaha uayile kuimbo liendi.
Kaha hajevene vamunehelelele muka kalepa uakosele ha muhela uendi. Kaha omo Yesu uamuene lutsilielo luavo, uahandekele kuli uje muka kalepa nguendi, “Simpa, munange, vupi vuove vana vusambuesa.”
Kaha vamo valongisi va Lishiko valihandekesele umo na mukuavo nguavo, “Ou yala alinakushaula Njambi!”
Vuno honi Yesu hakutantekeya viyongola viavo uahandekele nguendi, “Vika muli nakuyonguela viuma via vipi mu mitima yeni?
Nkuma cacasi cika kuhandeka nguange, vupi vuove vanavusambuesa, cipue kuhandeka nguange katuka uende?
Ngeci mutantekeye ngueni Muna Muntu hali na nzili yakama cikuma hano ha mavu yakusambuesa vupi.” Kaha uahandekele kuli uje muka kalepa nguendi, “Katuka, ambata muhela uove, kaha ya kuimbo!”
Kaha uakatukile, nakuya kuimbo.
Omo civunga vacimuene, vakele na liova, kaha vashangazalele Njambi, uje uahanene nzili yakama cikuma ku vantu.
Yesu Asana Mateu
Omo Yesu uahumine kuje ku cihela, uamuene yala ivatumbula nguavo Mateu uatumamene mu njivo ya kutambuila lisimo. Kaha uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Njikave.” Kaha uakatukile nakumukava.
Omo uatumamene ku mesa mu njivo, kaha vavengi vaka kutambula lisimo na vaka vupi vezile nakutumama hamo na Yesu na vandongisi vendi.
Kaha omo Vafaliseo vacimuene, vahandekele kuli vandongisi vendi nguavo, “Vika mulongisi ueni alinakulia na vaka kutambula lisimo na vaka vupi?”
Vuno honi omo uavevuile, uahandekele nguendi, “Vakangule kuvekusetela cimbanda, vuno honi kuvanga lika vaka kuvavala.
Yemuye mukalilongese vika eci cilumbunuka, ‘Njishunguiya cikeketima, keti cikombelo.’ Muomu kunjezile mukusana vaka vusunga, vuno honi vaka vupi.”
Cihula ca ha kuliumina Kulia
Kaha vandongisi va Iuano muka kumbuitika vezile kuli ikeye nakuhandeka nguavo, “Vika yetu na Vafaliseo tukaliumina kulia, vuno honi vandongisi vove kuvekuliumina kulia?”

Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Nkuma vangenzi vaje vali ku ciuano ca vulo vanapande kulila oku liavenia vulo acili navo ndi? Matangua akeja omo uje liavenia vulo vakamuambata hali vakevo ambahoni vakaliumine kulia.
“Naumo uahi asa kutongela citope ca ntanga yaiha ha kazaku kalaja, omuo cije citope caciha cikatavula kaje kazaku kaha mukasala mbengua yakama kupulakana mu muje yakele.

Naumo uahi asa kuhaka viniu via viha mu vinjenge via vilambu via laja, nga mulinga ngoco kaha vije vinjeke via vilambu vikatavuka, kaha vije viniu vikahitila muangoco na vije vilambu kaha vikapihia, vuno honi viniu via viha vaka vihaka mu vinjeke via vilambu via viha kaha mukulinga ngoco vioshe vivali vikakala muacili.”
Muna Njailosi ua Mumbanda na Mpuevo uje uakuatele ku Cikovelo ca Yesu

Te Yesu acilinakuhandeka navo, taleni muka kuyula ua Vayunda uezile kuli ikeye nakumutsikamena, uahandekele nguendi, “Munange ua mumbanda natsi hano vene, vuno honi ija nakumusaleka livoko liove, kaha akayoya.”
Kaha Yesu uakatukile nakumukava hamo na vandongisi vendi.
Kaha taleni, mpuevo uje uayandele ku mushongo ua kuhita maninga ha miaka yakupua likumi na ivali uezile munima yendi kaha uamukuatele ku mukunduilo ua kazaku kendi,
omuo uahandekele kuli ikeye vavenia nguendi, “Nga njikuata lika ku kazaku kendi kaha njikanguka.”
Omo Yesu uatengulukile uamumuene kaha uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Simpa, munange ua mpuevo, lutsilielo luove luakukanguisa.” Kaha hajevene uje mpuevo uakangukile.
Kaha omo Yesu uakovelele mu njivo ya uje mukuluntu ua masualale, uamuene vaje vakakuimba miaso yaha viakutsa na civunga cakele nakulila,
Kaha uahandekele nguendi, “Tuhukeni! Omuo ou kanike uampuevo katsile vuno honi nakosa lika.” Kaha vamujolele.
Vuno honi omo civunga catuhukile hambanza, uakovelele mukati kaha uakuatele uje kanike ku livoko nakumuhindula, kaha uje kanike uahindukile.
Kaha muzimbu ou ualishanduokelele mu mbonge yoshe ije.
Yesu Akanguisa Tupuputua Vavali
Kaha omo Yesu uahumine kuje, tupuputua vavali vamukavele, vatambekele nguavo, “Tuivuileko cikeketima Muna Ndaviti,”
Omo uakovelele mu njivo, vaje tupuputua vavali vezile kuli ikeye, kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Mutsiliela ngueni njasa kucilinga eci ndi?” Kaha vamukumbuluile nguavo, “Eyo Muene.”
Ambahoni uakuatele ha mesho avo nakuhandeka nguendi, “Kuya ku lutsilielo lueni cilingiue ngocovene kuli yeni.”
Kaha mesho avo emukile, kaha Yesu uavashikile nguendi, “Keti mukalekeko muntu cipue umo.”
Vuno honi vaile nakushanduola lutsimo luendi mu mbonge muoshe muje.
Yesu Akanguisa Kaveveve
Omo vaje vamala vakele nakuya, kaha kuakele vamo vantu vanehelelele Yesu yala ua kaveveve uje uakele na lihamba.
Kaha omo lije lihamba valihumisile, uje yala ua kaveveve uaputukile kuhandeka, kaha vivunga via valikomokelele cikuma nakuhandeka nguavio, “Nacimo cahi cakufua ngue eci cituamona muno mu Isaleli.”
Vuno honi Vafaliseo vahandekele nguavo, “Akahumisa mahamba na nzili ya muene ua mahamba.”
Yesu Ovuila Vantu Cikeketima
Kaha Yesu uendanganene mu vimbonge vioshe na mu membo oshe, uakele nakulongesa mu vinjivo viavo via malombelo nakuambulula muzimbu uacili ua vumuene, uakanguisile mishongo yoshe na mavezi oshe.
Omo uamuene vivunga via vantu kaha uavivuililile ngozi, omuo vakele nakulinienga nakuhona viakulinga ngue vampanga vaje vakuhona kaniungi.
Kaha uahandekele kuli vandongisi vendi nguendi, “Viakuteja vinapu viavingi vuno honi vaka kupanga vavandende.
Nankuma lombeleni kuli Muene ua vaka kuteja linga atume vaka kupanga kuviakuteja viendi.”
